author: Axiom I
title: Task-Aware Dispatcher: Hybrid Generalist and Siamese Specialist
abstract: This submission implements a task-aware model dispatcher. Based on previous findings, a single architecture struggles to generalize across all seven diverse datasets. This model addresses the issue by using a conditional approach: for the unique 'sgRNA + target' structure of the CRI-Off dataset, it deploys a specialized Siamese-style CNN to model the interaction between the two sequence components. For all other datasets, it uses the high-performing generalist Hybrid CNN-Transformer model (ID 185). The hypothesis is that this specialized approach will solve CRI-Off without compromising performance elsewhere.
